text:
zoe_mkt: quick micro-sync  we need a focused SEO ops bundle for next week's webinar push. scope = webinar landing, hero post, 3 pillar posts, thank-you page. must have: redirect CSV, keyword clusters, JSON-LD snippets, internal anchor map, UTM pattern. deadline: Tue EOD for staging QA.

omar_seo: i'll do keyword clusters (primary + 2 longtails each) and the redirect CSV. keep redirects minimal just merges and temp tracking lanes.

kelly_prod: messaging pick: "predictable latency" vs "cost controls" ? Which goes into meta description and H1?

ben_growth: A/B test summary: "predictable latency" nudged higher signups in acquisition cohorts. recommend hero H1/meta = predictable latency, use cost in remarketing. CTA: use "See demo" primary.

omar_seo: sample redirect rows (will attach full CSV to ticket):

old_path,new_path,type,reason
/blog/launch-draft,/blog/launch-hero,301,merge duplicates
/webinar-preview,/webinar,302,temp validate tracking
/offer/old-thanks,/thanks,301,consolidate

omar_seo: schema plan: webinar landing -> Event JSON-LD (name,startDate,url,organizer). blogs -> BlogPosting with mainEntityOfPage + image + author. tiny stub I'll paste to the ticket: {"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Webinar","startDate":"2025-04-15T16:00:00Z","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinar","organizer":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference"}}

kelly_prod: anchor map: hero article should link to pillar A (intro) and pillar B (how-to) in the first 40% of content; webinar landing right-rail -> pillar C and thank-you. use descriptive anchors, not exact-match spaghetti.

ben_growth: UTM pattern: utm_source=webinar_launch, utm_medium=cta, utm_campaign=spring25, utm_content={hero|email|social}. HubSpot routing will use utm_content.

natalie_eng: redirect window Wed 04:00-05:00 UTC. plan: apply 302s, run analytics smoke tests, flip to 301 once tracking and smoke tests pass. we'll add rel=canonical Link header on duplicates during flip. SRE will monitor logs and page load traces.

ops-bot: Ticket created: #MK-21021 "Webinar SEO micro-bundle: redirects, schema, anchors, UTMs"  assignees: omar_seo, kelly_prod, ben_growth, natalie_eng. Reminder scheduled for 2025-04-08T09:00:00Z. :white_check_mark:

zoe_mkt: perfect  action list recap: Omar -> keywords + redirect CSV + JSON-LD by Tue 11:00. Kelly -> anchor placements + CTA text by Tue 14:00. Ben -> UTMs + heatmap summary by Tue 15:00. Natalie -> schedule redirect job + SRE handoff. I'll run preflight Tue after deliverables. :rocket:
